description: This Python module prepares and combines Bokeh plots for the 'Temperature' tab in a dashboard, specifically for monitoring MCE (Mechanical Cooler Electronics) voltages and currents across different boards and quadrants, and assembling them into a tab layout.

methods.name: msa_mce_plots
methods.description: Creates a dashboard tab combining multiple Bokeh plots related to MCE voltages and currents, with an accompanying description table.
